title: Prompt Injection Case-Sensitivity Evasion
symptom: Attack prompts using uppercase (e.g., "IGNORE PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS") completely bypass detection.
rootCause: RegExp literal lacks the "i" flag, enforcing strict lowercase ASCII matching only.
fixStrategy: Append the "i" modifier and precompile to an immutable static pattern.

title: Off-By-One Boundary Truncation in Token Window
symptom: Substrings spanning window boundaries (e.g., 3-word trigger phrases) miss the 3rd word and are ignored.
rootCause: Array.prototype.slice end argument is non-inclusive; subtracting 1 causes only 2 tokens to be taken instead of 3.
fixStrategy: Pass (i, i + windowSize) so that exactly 3 tokens are extracted in each sliding step.

title: String Coercion Arithmetic on Cumulative Risk Score
flawedSnippet:
const ruleWeight: any = '40';
riskScore += ruleWeight; // result is "040"
symptom: Risk score becomes string concatenation ("040"), distorting arithmetic comparisons and evaluation thresholds.
rootCause: Weakly typed dynamic addition where numeric 0 concatenated with string "40" yields "040" rather than 40.
fixStrategy: Enforce strict TypeScript numeric types (number) and explicit integer addition.

title: Null Pointer Dereference on Missing Metadata
symptom: Calling sanitizePrompt without context or with context: {} throws uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined.
rootCause: Direct deep property access on optional parameter without optional chaining or defensive falsy check.
fixStrategy: Use optional chaining context?.metadata?.environment with nullish coalescing default value fallback.

title: Catastrophic ReDoS Backtracking in Malicious Regex
fixedSnippet: // Removed polynomial nested quantifier. Replaced with linear O(N) scanner.
symptom: Processing a 30-character repetitive malicious string hangs Node.js/Vite thread with 100% CPU usage.
rootCause: Nested unbounded quantifiers (a+)* trigger exponential backtracking O(2^N) permutations on non-matching suffix.
fixStrategy: Flatten regular expression into deterministic linear pattern and add max input length boundary guard.

title: Inverted Boolean Gate on Admin Whitelist Authorization
fixedSnippet:
const isAdmin = context?.userRole === 'admin';
const isSafe = isAdmin ? numericRiskScore < 80 : numericRiskScore < 50;
symptom: Admin users with safe score (e.g. 0) are incorrectly rejected (isSafe = false), while malicious admins pass!
rootCause: Ternary condition has inverted branch logic (riskScore > 50 evaluated as safe for admins).
fixStrategy: Correct the comparison operators: admins are permitted elevated threshold (score < 80) vs standard users (score < 50).

title: Global Regex lastIndex Mutation Flaw (State Leak)
fixedSnippet: private static readonly API_KEY_PATTERN = /AIza[0-9A-Za-z-_]{35}/; // Non-global RegExp
symptom: Consecutive identical calls with valid API keys alternate between true and false!
rootCause: RegExp with global (/g) flag retains stateful lastIndex pointer across subsequent .test() executions.
fixStrategy: Remove the global flag for boolean tests or reset lastIndex = 0 before execution.

title: Single-Occurrence Replacement PII Data Leak
symptom: Prompts containing multiple credit card numbers only redact the first card, leaking the rest!
rootCause: String.prototype.replace with non-global regex only replaces the first occurrence.
fixStrategy: Use global flag /g with word boundaries \b to mask all instances in the payload.
